# Porcelain Current

The founding entry of the Dash Design Library commons.

## Principles
- One material, carved by light: raised invites, inset holds, pressed commits.
- One electric current per view — light is spent, never scattered.
- Text never animates; surfaces speak, words hold still.

## Type
Sora for headlines (700-800), Inter for body (18px), IBM Plex Mono for kickers and data.

## The rule that matters
If a cut does not remove meaning, keep cutting.
